name: Routes Traffic
description: A load balancer, DNS zone, route table or PrivateLink endpoint service routes traffic to a target (source -> target). A load balancer routes to the instances and functions in its target groups (DescribeTargetHealth); a hosted zone to the load balancers and CloudFront distributions its alias records name; an endpoint service forwards its consumers' traffic to the Network or Gateway Load Balancer behind it. One edge per source and target.

destination_cidr.description: Destination CIDR block for route table entries.

port.description: Target port for load balancer routing.
